HCC registrational trials planned 2026

BGB-B2033 got FDA Fast Track
Expedited review can shorten time to market if pivotal data are positive.
Orphan status for HCC in US and EU
May confer exclusivity and incentives, improving potential returns.
Initial PRMT5 inhibitor data in NSCLC
Early systemic and intracranial activity in MTAP-deficient NSCLC broadens pipeline optionality.
CEA ADC BG-C477 FDA Fast Track
Regulatory de-risking; management intends late-stage move in 2027.
Phase 3 CDK4 trial now enrolling
